_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the token lint (scripts/design/check-tokens.mjs, ADR-0081). Every entry needs a reason. A file entry exempts the whole file; a match entry exempts lines of that file containing the text.

files.reason: Illustrations of the six products use their own palette. DESIGN.md lists illustrations and product art as things a template does not change. Redraw in token colours when the products get new art.

lines.reason: Inline code is sized relative to the surrounding text (em), which a rem token cannot express.
